answer: Best chain in the current default garnet calibration (set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade) is QB11-QB12-QB7. The IRB CZ fidelities are QB12-QB11 = 0.998693 and QB12-QB7 = 0.998016, so the product is about 0.996712.
